note.question: What role does dynamic inventory repositioning play in on-demand rental networks?
note.overview: The model considers a rental service with a fixed number of rental units distributed across multiple locations. The units are accessed by customers without prior reservation and on an on-demand basis. Customers can decide on how long to keep a unit and where to return it.
